scenario_description:
Objective: Secure an optional advance two-seat listening hold for Sahana and Tsering during their confirmed museum visit.
Emerging Need: Registration and the final seat notice open a concrete free amenity with Mustang migration oral histories that matches Tsering’s stored preference.
Decision Context: The receipt identifies the registered pair; Nima has separate admission and an independent gallery plan. Stored permission supports only a reversible private hold, not paid add-ons or recorded participation.
Consequence: Missing 14:20 loses certainty of an advance hold, while museum admission and a possible walk-up attempt remain available.

parameter.subject: Saturday Himalayan Crossroads extras
parameter.body: This Saturday's Himalayan Crossroads gallery day includes an optional 12-minute oral-history listening alcove for registered timed-entry visitors. Any no-cost two-seat holds require a timed-entry confirmation code and can only be requested after the same-day seat notice is posted later this week. The alcove is separate from admission and does not affect gallery entry.

parameter.content: Appa noticed the Himalayan Crossroads poster and said the photos looked familiar, but let's wait until tomorrow to decide about Saturday. If Pema can come by after lunch and the weather stays mild, the museum afternoon might be nice.

parameter.title: Queens Museum Himalayan Crossroads afternoon
parameter.description: Confirmed family museum visit. Sahana and Tsering will use the two-person timed-entry registration; Nima has his own separately arranged admission and plans to browse the photography gallery during any optional two-seat listening break.
parameter.location: Queens Museum, Flushing Meadows Corona Park

parameter.description: Pay-what-you-wish timed-entry registration for Sahana Noor Tamang and Tsering Tamang on 2026-06-13 at 13:00. Nima has separate admission and is not included in QM613-NOOR-2.

parameter.subject: Himalayan Crossroads listening alcove: one advance hold left
parameter.body: For June 13 13:00 timed-entry visitors, one two-seat listening alcove advance hold remains at 13:25. This week’s twelve-minute selection is Mustang migration oral histories, with no interview or recorded participation. The hold is free, reversible until 10:00 Saturday and requires only the timed-entry confirmation code. Requests before 14:20 today are handled before walk-up release; a hold covers the registered pair only.

parameter.subject: Himalayan Crossroads listening alcove advance holds closed
parameter.body: Advance holds for Saturday's Himalayan Crossroads listening alcove are now closed, and the remaining 1:25 p.m. slot has been released to the walk-up queue. Timed-entry admission remains unchanged, but Visitor Services cannot add further advance alcove holds for this program.
